answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, as each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The pulse cap is enforced at intake and onyx publishes the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a sonnet tag. That is 36 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
